rule: Append unfavorable, blocked, interrupted, or scientifically invalid attempts; never delete them to make a lineage look successful.

entries.lesson: Demotion/recheck evidence did not justify an operational policy change.
Sequential runtime and heavyweight per-dataset validation required deterministic checkpoint/resume redesign.
Parallelism alone did not solve repeated source validation, parent-log, checkpoint, and environment integration failures. Preserve explicit modes and compact state.
Never evaluate until both frozen prediction and manifest exist.
Preserve verified nonterminal evidence, selectively recompute/abstain terminal identity-insufficient records, and never rerun all expensive work blindly.
Independent adversarial review is required before long execution; progress claims without exact context, inode, cleanup, and resume evidence are insufficient.

Frozen operational lanes are sparse routed-coordinate exclusions, not complete TEST coverage. Validate each lane coordinate as a member of the descriptor-bound TEST identity set without requiring equality, and preserve every no-clobber smoke root.
